title: The extremal Reissner-Nordström throat from non extremal near horizon expansions
summary: The near horizon region of a non extremal black hole has a universal Rindler form, but the strict horizon limit is not an ordinary Lorentzian geometry. In the String Carroll expansion of this non extremal near horizon metric,the transverse angular directions form a base and the time-radial Rindler directions appear as a distinguished two-dimensional longitudinal sector fibered over this base. We study how this String Carroll expansion behaves for the Reissner-Nordström (RN) black hole as the extremal limit is approached, where the expected near horizon geometry is the Lorentzian $AdS_2…
